text: This is to be asserted in general of men, that they are ungrateful, fickle, false, cowardly, covetous, and as long as you succeed they are yours entirely; they will offer you their blood, property, life, and children... when the need is far distant; but when it approaches they turn against you.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter XVII, Concerning cruelty and clemency, and whether it is better to be loved than feared
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
